description: This file contains implementation of various command classes and snapshot management for a calculator application's view model, including classes for unary, binary, operand, and parentheses commands, as well as snapshot classes for history, display, and expression states.

classes.name: UnaryCommand
classes.description: Represents a unary command with a list of command integers.

classes.name: BinaryCommand
classes.description: Represents a binary command with a single command integer.

classes.name: OperandCommand
classes.description: Represents an operand command with flags for negativity, decimal presence, scientific format, and a list of command integers.

classes.name: Parentheses
classes.description: Represents a parentheses command with a command integer.

classes.name: CalcManagerToken
classes.description: Represents a token in the calculator's history, including an opcode name and command index.

classes.name: CalcManagerHistoryItem
classes.description: Represents a history item containing tokens, commands, expression, and result.

classes.name: PrimaryDisplaySnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of the primary display value and error state.

classes.name: ExpressionDisplaySnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of the expression display, including tokens and commands.

classes.name: StandardCalculatorSnapshot
classes.description: Comprehensive snapshot including history, display, and expression states.

methods.name: CreateExprCommand
methods.description: Factory function to create expression command objects based on command type.
